approvers: Developer or main contractor, project director, procurement
reason: Protection is set in the subcontract package and the developer decides who pays, so I can't add a 19 euro per m2 line on my own. We spend about 2,100 a year on the factory film and that has been fine for most of the programme.
objection: In July and August half the facade is in full sun. When can you even apply it, and how does it come off cleanly after months of heat? Also a new applicator on my glazing means I carry the risk if it marks the glass.
instead: Keep the factory film on the profiles, tape and board in the problem areas, and have the glazier clean the glass before handover.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or main contractor who specifies it and pays for it in the package, plus a local reference job in summer heat where it came off with no marks.
